tools.name: fetch_system_text_report
tools.description: Fetches the latest internal system status report in markdown format. Use this when you need logs, uptime data, or infrastructure metrics.

tools.name: fetch_system_image_metadata
tools.description: Fetches metadata for internal simulated image generation pipelines. Use this to inspect dimensions, formats, and mock URLs for rendering.

tools.name: check_core_api_health
tools.description: Checks whether the internal Core API backend is running and reachable.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Gets the current weather and a 3-day forecast for any city. Returns nested data including temperature, humidity, wind, and daily highs/lows.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Searches the internal staff directory. Optionally filter by a free-text query (name/role/team) and/or an exact team name. Returns a list of matching users.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetches one staff member by their id (e.g. u-1001). Returns an error if the id does not exist.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Lists current operational incidents. Optionally filter by severity (low/medium/high/critical) and status (open/resolved). The list changes over time to simulate a live feed.

tools.name: get_service_metrics
tools.description: Returns a time-series of metrics for a named service. Choose window (1h/24h/7d) and metric (latency_ms/error_rate/rps). Includes min/max/avg summary and the raw datapoints for trend analysis.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Gets the latest simulated market price and 24h change for a ticker symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, AAPL, NVDA). Prices move between calls.

tools.name: get_sensor_reading
tools.description: Reads live telemetry for a warehouse IoT sensor by id, including temperature, humidity, battery, and any out-of-range alert.

tools.name: call_flaky_service
tools.description: Calls an unreliable internal service that fails about 40% of the time with a 503 error. Useful for testing how you handle transient failures and retries.

tools.name: call_slow_service
tools.description: Calls a deliberately slow endpoint that waits the given number of seconds before responding. Useful for testing timeouts.

tools.name: get_dev_joke
tools.description: Returns a random developer joke. A light-weight tool for testing plain-text responses.
